title: Conformance test catalogue
preamble:
# Conformance test catalogue

The format of the fixtures in
`specs/conformance/`, the suite every DS runtime is judged by, so
that every runtime's harness reads a fixture the same way; how the
catalogue is versioned; and when a fixture is added.

Paired with:

- [LCON] — the categories the fixtures test.
- [RTIM] — the harness that runs them.
- [LDET] — the determinism guarantee they verify.

## What this is not

- Not the test-harness spec (see [RTIM]).
- Not a list of tests. The fixtures are the list.
